lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with inter-blob distance increasing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows, creating a defined grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges display a sharp luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge, spanning the length of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal Echeneidae organisms are visible attached to the primary pectoral fin and trailing beneath the ventral-lateral surface.
